This is a Quarto website.

To learn more about Quarto websites visit <https://quarto.org/docs/websites>.

Start by choosing a [theme](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-themes.html) and setting it in [`_quarto.yml`](./_quarto.yml):

```yaml
format:
  html:
    theme: <set it here>
```

And then setting a [layout](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-about.html) here in [this page's](./index.qmd) YAML block:

```yaml
about:
  template: <set it here>
```

Add more pages by making more `.qmd` files in the root folder and then linking to them in your text or adding them to the navbar in [_quarto.yml](./quarto.yml):

```yaml
website:
  title: "Example Website"
  navbar:
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - about.qmd
```


Now you can keep changing the YAML blocks for more customization! Here are some more things you can add:

a) A main site image:

```yaml
image: <path to image>
image-alt: "<text describing your image>"
```

b) Fancy links to your social media/Google Scholar/etc:

```yaml
about:
  links:
    - text:
      icon:
      url:

```

c) Bibliography 

```yaml
bibliography: <path to a .bib file>
```

Whatever you in-text cite using the `@<code for a given citation source>` will then automatically be added to that pages bibliography

Then add the following where you want your bibliography to appear:

```markdown
# References
```

### How did I set this up?

1) Created a new folder
2) Ran this in the command line `quarto create project website` and followed the prompts
3) Made the [publish.yml file](./.github/workflows/publish.yml) which should be copy/pasted directly
4) Published the repo to Github
5) In Github, added a "gh-pages" branch
6) Went to "Settings > Pages" to get my URL

Then I had a website!

### Want a custom domain?

1) Buy a domain name
2) In the advanced DNS settings add the following which are for Github Pages:

| Type         | Host | Value                  | TTL       |
|--------------|------|------------------------|-----------|
| A Record     | @    | 185.199.108.153        | Automatic |
| A Record     | @    | 185.199.109.153        | Automatic |
| A Record     | @    | 185.199.110.153        | Automatic |
| A Record     | @    | 185.199.111.153        | Automatic |
| AAAA Record  | @    | 2606:50c0:8000::153   | Automatic |
| AAAA Record  | @    | 2606:50c0:8001::153   | Automatic |
| AAAA Record  | @    | 2606:50c0:8003::153   | Automatic |
| CNAME Record | www  | <Your Github Username>.github.io. | Automatic |

3) Add a new file in your root folder called "CNAME" and only add the following text to it: www.<Your URL>.com
4) Commit/push
5) Go to "Settings > Pages" to add your custom URL
